purpose: Prospectively test whether a parameter-free, model-native zero-logit same-span consensus guard lets FRC abstain on missing evidence while preserving evidence selection for entailment and contradiction in untouched long contracts.

pre_registration_access_disclosure.probe_result: The web reader rejected application/x-zip-compressed content and did not expose, save, list or open archive bytes.

source_access_order: Freeze this protocol, implementation, runner and synthetic tests and register their SHA-256 values.
Download the official archive to the ignored benchmark cache without opening it and register byte length and SHA-256.
List member names only; require exactly one test JSON and permanently refuse to open train or dev JSON.
Open the test JSON once to perform the frozen structural census and deterministic sampling.
Create a label-free blind cache and a private commitment map; validate exact evidence ceiling before neural scoring.
Register the CUDA execution environment and every blind artifact hash before scoring.
Generate deterministic queries and score every sampled candidate without labels or evidence spans.
Reopen only the frozen test JSON after the complete score cache exists, join labels and evidence, evaluate once, publish any outcome and forbid v50 reuse for tuning.

sampling: Validate that each case has one of the three registered labels, that NotMentioned has no evidence indices, and that Entailment or Contradiction has at least one valid evidence span.
Within each label, sort cases by SHA-256 of the frozen salt, label, document id and hypothesis key.
Attempt a quota of 200 cases per label with a maximum of six sampled hypotheses per document.
If a label has fewer than 200 eligible cases, fill the remaining slots from every unselected eligible case in one global frozen-hash order while preserving the six-per-document cap.
Fail before query generation if fewer than 500 cases or the exact 600-case target cannot be formed.

blind_candidate_construction.candidate_unit: Each official ContractNLI span is one indivisible candidate with canonical id span_NNNN and official Python-style half-open character offsets.

frozen_models.query_generation_reason: The fixed ContractNLI hypothesis is already the query; diagnostic role queries are deterministic templates so missing-evidence behavior is not confounded by generative parser failures.

query_templates.first_fact: Find contract language that directly entails or supports the following statement: {hypothesis}
query_templates.second_fact_or_bridge: Find contract language that contradicts, negates, or rules out the following statement: {hypothesis}
query_templates.counterevidence: Find exceptions, exclusions, limitations, or scope conditions relevant to the following statement: {hypothesis}

candidate_method_formula: Use the reranker's raw pre-minmax logit; zero is the model-native binary decision boundary and no empirical threshold is fitted.
For each candidate span, compute the raw anchor, support, contradiction and exception-role logits using the frozen deterministic queries.
The anchor gate passes if any span has anchor_logit greater than zero.
The dual-polarity same-span consensus gate passes if any one span has anchor_logit greater than zero and either support_logit or contradiction_logit greater than zero.

The v50 candidate returns an empty evidence set when the consensus gate fails; when it passes, it uses the unchanged v43 adaptive argmax-cardinality target and unchanged v41 dynamic rank-coverage selector.
Every shared-consensus non-FRC control uses the identical consensus gate before its unchanged selector; the anchor-gate FRC control uses the identical v43 selector with only the anchor gate.
The exception role can influence the unchanged dynamic FRC selection but cannot alone open the evidence-existence gate.
No dataset-derived score quantile, temperature, margin, label prior, document statistic or post-result rule may alter the zero threshold, same-span condition, selector or budget.

per_case_metric: For Entailment and Contradiction, maximum evidence-set F1 against the single official evidence reference.
For NotMentioned, 1 only when the selected evidence set is empty and 0 otherwise.
secondary_metrics: evidence-bearing macro F1, precision, recall and complete evidence recall
mean selected unit count and token cost
paired utility deltas by token budget and supported strata
evaluation.official_span_nli_bert: Paper reference only: no released compatible trained weight is claimed or simulated, and it is not included in executable baseline comparisons.

known_scope_limits: This is bounded full-contract evidence selection and abstention on fixed NDA hypotheses, not open-corpus retrieval or ContractNLI end-to-end NLI classification.
The balanced deterministic sample is a mechanism stress test and must not be presented as the natural test-set prevalence.
ContractNLI is legal-domain evidence and does not replace independent flood-domain expert evaluation.
A positive result would support only the frozen native-zero abstention guard; it would not reproduce Span NLI BERT, SetR or any unavailable trained model.
